name: MACD Trend
description: Goes long SPY when the MACD signal deviates upward by more than 1% and liquidates when it turns down. Daily resolution over 2004-2015, so this one produces a real multi-year equity curve.

name: EMA Cross (parameterised)
description: Fast/slow exponential moving average crossover on SPY. Both periods are tunable, which makes this the algorithm to use for exploring how a parameter change moves the statistics.

name: Framework Template
description: The algorithm framework stack end to end: manual universe selection, an EMA cross alpha model, equal weighting and immediate execution.

name: Basic Template
description: Buys and holds SPY for a week of minute data. The smallest thing that exercises the whole engine, useful as a smoke test.
